scope: Only manually annotated Gold-train language labels and explicit M2/M3 generator alignment traces
interpretation_warning: Gold percentages measure authentic French presence or preservation. M2/M3 percentages measure deliberate synthetic French insertion. They are prevalence and exposure indicators, not estimates of one identical event.

excluded_from_quantitative_comparison.M1: No deliberate code-switching mechanism; total French presence is not traced.
excluded_from_quantitative_comparison.M4: No token-language labels or detailed generation traces.
excluded_from_quantitative_comparison.M6: No deliberate French insertion; language labels are used for protection.
